purpose: Machine-readable mechanism index for NIVAR G2.2 craft research

references.name: 60fps CRED persistent morph
references.mechanism: Hero object shrinks/morphs into persistent navigation/progress state.
references.nivar_use: Make EV-001 visually persistent across hero chapters and potentially through Portal scroll.
references.do_not_copy: Credit-card styling, color, copy, commerce interaction.

references.name: 60fps Must Movie Collection
references.mechanism: Scene builds in staggered parts and selected object expands through shared-element continuity.
references.nivar_use: Build evidence/dashboard panels from datum, unit, time, gaps, axes and interpretation rather than spawning finished panels.

references.name: 60fps Must Movie Detail Sheet
references.mechanism: Context expands from a precise source position and returns to it.
references.nivar_use: Source/provenance or Terminal observation expands without losing spatial origin.

references.name: 60fps Harvee graph morph
references.mechanism: Graph geometry morphs between analytical contexts.
references.nivar_use: Region/metric/period changes preserve data identity rather than hard swapping charts.

references.name: 60fps Revolut graph scrub
references.mechanism: Probe, selected point, number and timestamp update as one state.
references.nivar_use: Terminal probe synchronizes line, value, time, note, source and region.

references.name: 60fps Strava review story
references.mechanism: Distinct chapter visuals stay coherent through one progress/story system.
references.nivar_use: Give each family verb a motion signature inside one hero narrative.

references.name: 60fps FocusFlight depth transition
references.mechanism: Current scene retreats in depth as next scene advances.
references.nivar_use: Physical world to evidence to analysis transitions without hard cuts.

references.name: 60fps Pool sticky header
references.mechanism: Persistent visual state keeps orientation during long scroll.
references.nivar_use: Method/house progress indicator during Portal choreography.

references.name: Media.Work
references.mechanism: Near-full-viewport physical imagery with tiny metadata gives texture and scale priority.
references.nivar_use: Infrastructure and Hardware scenes where reality owns the stage and overlays stay light.

references.name: DGC
references.mechanism: Stable framing with receding/moving image planes creates cinematic depth.
references.nivar_use: Hero/family chapter handoff with continuing planes instead of resetting composition.

references.name: The Spark
references.mechanism: Story-first immersive site behaves like a short film instead of a marketing page with effects.
references.nivar_use: Treat NIVAR hero as one directed film system with narrative continuity.
references.do_not_copy: The Spark artwork, scene design or brand.

references.name: The Spark engineering write-up
references.mechanism: Narrative, motion and web engineering are designed together.
references.nivar_use: Technical plan for hero should start from story beats, performance and transition mechanics together.
references.do_not_copy: Implementation blindly; use as process reference.

references.name: Lightship by Locomotive
references.mechanism: Progressive disclosure and immersive 3D explain technical product complexity.
references.nivar_use: Software/Ariadne and Hardware reveal complexity in ordered stages.

references.name: Vev scrollytelling guide
references.mechanism: Scroll acts as timeline with pinned media and staged state transitions.
references.nivar_use: Portal method/house chapters and light-to-dark transition.

references.name: Origin Financial
references.mechanism: Public brand environment transitions into dark product without feeling like a pasted screenshot.
references.nivar_use: Software should cross a material threshold into Terminal.

references.name: Linear
references.mechanism: Stable workspace geometry while state and explanation resolve in-place.
references.nivar_use: Ariadne selection propagates through stable map/chart/source attention points.

references.name: Dovetail
references.mechanism: Dark base, working plane, raised contextual inspector.
references.nivar_use: Terminal source/interpretation plane with visible underlying context.
references.do_not_copy: Brand color and product hierarchy wholesale.

references.name: Fey via Refero
references.mechanism: Matte dark data environment with fine edge light and sparse luminous boundaries.
references.nivar_use: Terminal material hierarchy and desire.

references.name: Basedash Refero
references.mechanism: Dark data surface with sparse accent and selective editorial serif.
references.nivar_use: Audit Terminal signal-to-substrate ratio and mono texture density.

references.name: INVERSA Refero
references.mechanism: Earth/topographic field and editorial narrative coexist with sparse command UI.
references.nivar_use: Geographic Terminal field and territorial storytelling.

references.name: Steep Refero
references.mechanism: Analytics presented with editorial confidence rather than dashboard framing.
references.nivar_use: Intelligence and Energy Brief.

references.name: Monad Refero
references.mechanism: Editorial serif plus technical mono creates publication/manual hybrid.
references.nivar_use: Energy Brief, methodology, source labels.

references.name: Our World in Data source treatment
references.mechanism: Source and transformation disclosure stay adjacent to visualization.
references.nivar_use: Provenance as an active reading affordance.

references.name: NASA Brand Center
references.mechanism: Master identity coexists with supplemental mission/team marks.
references.nivar_use: NIVAR house mark separate from Diógenes and family patrons.
references.do_not_copy: NASA worm, meatball, patches or type.

references.name: Logobook N archive
references.mechanism: Broad historical archive exposes negative space, silhouette and limited interventions.
references.nivar_use: Wordmark/monogram research beyond SaaS trends.

references.name: Recent Figure Mark Collection
references.mechanism: Human marks read through silhouette and gesture first.
references.nivar_use: If micro family marks remain, reduce around action/gesture rather than abstract symbolism.

references.name: Recent Six Bespoke Typefaces
references.mechanism: Custom type can carry identity so icons do not bear all differentiation.
references.nivar_use: Strengthen NIVAR word/type ownership and reduce dependence on SVG family marks.

references.name: ThreeUI
references.mechanism: Reusable Three.js mechanisms for material planes, flows, arcs, fields and spatial transitions.
references.nivar_use: 3D Paper, Structure Flow, Predictive Arc, Constellation Field, Portal Field where semantics justify depth.
references.do_not_copy: Use components as decoration or imply Pro licensing covers unentitled code.

references.name: ThreeUI Community repo
references.mechanism: Open Community implementations can accelerate spatial UI research.
references.nivar_use: Adapt MIT Community code where appropriate and preserve notices.
references.do_not_copy: Pro/Beta implementation not present in Community repo.

references.name: GSAP ScrollTrigger
references.mechanism: Pin, scrub, snap, responsive matchMedia and scroll-linked timeline control.
references.nivar_use: Portal choreography, hero handoff, family chapters, Diógenes close.
references.do_not_copy: Do not introduce scroll-jacking to ordinary reading.

references.name: Motion React scroll
references.mechanism: Scroll-linked values, parallax/progress, spring smoothing and responsive React motion.
references.nivar_use: EV-001 continuity, Ariadne path, selected observations, small/medium state transitions.

references.name: Lenis
references.mechanism: Smooth scroll synchronization for WebGL/parallax when needed.
references.nivar_use: Only if hero/3D synchronization materially improves.
references.do_not_copy: Do not add scroll smoothing by default.

references.name: EPE Webmap
references.mechanism: Real Brazilian energy geography, layers, downloads, WMS and metadata.
references.nivar_use: Real map context for Terminal and territorial transitions.
references.do_not_copy: Use with attribution/licensing and verify dataset-specific terms.

references.name: EPE SIN map
references.mechanism: Official SIN geography reference.
references.nivar_use: Source-backed geographic visual language.
references.do_not_copy: Preserve CC BY 4.0 attribution and current source context.

references.name: ANEEL GGT
references.mechanism: Field photographic evidence integrates with geospatial transmission monitoring and performance management.
references.nivar_use: Semantic model for reality -> evidence -> geospatial system -> monitoring -> decision.
references.do_not_copy: Do not imply NIVAR is ANEEL or has GGT data unless connected.

references.name: Itaipu media bank
references.mechanism: Official high-quality media source for real Itaipu subject matter.
references.nivar_use: Research and potentially production after current permission/terms review.
references.do_not_copy: Do not assume public portal means unrestricted reuse.

references.name: Codrops ZERO
references.mechanism: Six-stage immersive scroll uses self-contained segment lifecycles coordinated by one master progress value and explicit interaction gates.
references.nivar_use: Model each NIVAR verb as a segment with enter/scrub/update/teardown and persistent EV-001 handoff.
references.do_not_copy: Frost, glass-shatter, tunnel or narrative aesthetics.

references.name: Codrops Podium
references.mechanism: Continuous sequence, restrained directional motion and synchronized GSAP/Lenis/Three.js rhythm.
references.nivar_use: Make Portal feel temporal and continuous rather than a stack of animated sections.

references.name: Codrops Ten Years Away
references.mechanism: Visual pieces arrive separately and assemble into the finished chapter composition.
references.nivar_use: Dashboards and evidence panels construct causally from datum/unit/time/gaps/axis/source before interpretation appears.

references.name: Codrops tutorial hub
references.mechanism: Current creative-development patterns for GSAP, Three.js, WebGL/WebGPU, Blender paths, masks and persistent transitions.
references.nivar_use: Technical idea bank after narrative mechanism is chosen.
references.do_not_copy: Do not choose an effect before identifying a semantic reason.
